title: Agentic Wi-Fi Spatial Attribution Readiness Platform — Reproducible Reference Core and Colab Notebooks
description:
Reproducible reference implementation of the core scientific machinery of an Agentic Wi-Fi Spatial Attribution Readiness Platform for Critical Information Infrastructure. The package provides explainable Bayesian localisation that fuses three modalities (RSSI fingerprinting, FTM/RTT ranging, and IEEE 802.11bf WLAN sensing) with robust likelihoods and an explicit missing-modality mask; uncertainty quantification (posterior, highest-posterior-density region, entropy, sharpness, zone probabilities, multimodality, calibration); cross-modal consistency scoring (HPD overlap, MAP Mahalanobis distance, Jensen-Shannon divergence) yielding CONSISTENT / UNCERTAIN / CONFLICT; a lightweight digital twin of the radio environment for synthetic telemetry, drift injection and twin-residual threat cues; a ten-agent event-driven orchestrator; a Technology / Commercialisation / Integration / Operational Readiness (TRL/CRL/IRL/OR) model with non-compensatory gate rules; and a hash-anchored, machine-readable Spatial Attribution Record (SAR) for SOC/SIEM/SOAR.

Two Google Colab notebooks are included: (1) an autonomous notebook that installs its own dependencies and runs the full pipeline from scratch, and (2) a pre-computed notebook with saved computations and visualisations (posterior heatmaps, HPD regions, calibration and readiness plots, adversarial-scenario comparison).

Note: all telemetry is synthetic; the artefact contains no real coordinates or configurations of any critical information infrastructure. No experimental performance advantage is claimed without data; limitations are documented.
notes: Synthetic data only. Reference/research artefact; not a production system. See README.md for reproducibility and limitations.
